promise: You could have a recession in six to nine months
description: At an Institute of International Finance event, Dimon said US inflation pressures meant a recession could arrive within 6-9 months (an expectation he repeated in his Jan 2023 Davos remarks about economic 'storm clouds'). No recession materialized: the US economy grew 2.5% in 2023 (strongest of the G7), and unemployment stayed near 50-year lows. The recession call, repeated by Dimon through late 2023, never occurred.
evidence: Bloomberg (Oct 10, 2022): 'JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon Expects US Recession in Six to Nine Months'
BEA: real US GDP grew 2.5% in 2023 — no recession in the predicted window
Dimon kept warning of recession through 2023; none occurred
